limitations: This is a structured first research pass across every title, not an exhaustive encyclopedia of every credited or minor character.

The original 619 character IDs and 836 appearance pairs were preserved; one additional Mai Zenin profile and its Jujutsu Kaisen appearance were added from the official anime character page. All title-level research statuses remain partial.
The new power/technique/weapon/tool/transformation datasets contain only a limited researched subset. They do not cover every character or every franchise in the title list.
Most image fields are empty because stable, continuity-specific official image URLs were not confirmed.
Most character occupation, aliases, affiliations, relationship, origin, weakness, and full biography fields remain empty unless supported by the existing profile or current source pass.
Character.role is a single summary field required by the requested Character interface. The authoritative role for a specific title is characterAppearances[].role.
Powers and transformations may be associated with a title only when the relevant character appears in that title; the per-title appearance file is the authoritative movie/series scope.
No title is marked fully researched. Further character-by-character research is still required.
